preludes.reason: Household size is not present as a single household-level column; it must be counted from the full person register (silc24_pr, all ages) and then used to normalize total household disposable income (HG110) to a per-capita welfare aggregate.
invariants: One row per hh_id present in silc24_h

bindings.evidence: Household size derived by counting silc24_pr.pers_id rows per silc24_pr.hh_id (full person register, all ages). (t3)
Per-capita welfare constructed in prelude as total household disposable income (silc24_h.hg110) divided by household size from silc24_pr. (t3)
Nominal welfare set equal to per-capita disposable income constructed from silc24_h.hg110 and silc24_pr-based household size. (t3)
Shared prosperity welfare set to the same per-capita disposable income aggregate as welfare, constructed using silc24_h.hg110 and silc24_pr-based household size. (t3)
silc24_h.hg110 is labelled Total household disposable income, i.e. an income concept. (t3)
Shared prosperity aggregate uses the same income-based welfare as welfare (hg110 / hsize), so type is income. (t3)

absent.reason: No spatially-deflated/real welfare aggregate column is present in silc24_h; while a region identifier exists, the referenced deflators table is not bindable in this delivery.
No secondary final welfare aggregate (consumption/expenditure alternative) is present; only the income aggregate HG110 is apparent in silc24_h.
Because no secondary welfare aggregate is present (welfareother absent), no corresponding welfareothertype can be sourced.

notes: Updated prelude to count household members from silc24_pr (all ages) instead of silc24_p (15+), fixing hsize and per-capita welfare.
